## About
Beltway Used Auto Parts is an environmentally conscious recycler on Kenilworth Avenue in Hyattsville. We specialize in late model auto and truck parts, both foreign and domestic, and our inventory is updated daily through our yard management system.
Need a part shipped or dropped off? We ship UPS, FedEx and freight, and our own trucks deliver around Maryland, Delaware, Virginia, the District of Columbia and Pennsylvania. Got a vehicle you want to sell? Give us a call for a bid. Se habla espanol.

## Services
- Late model auto and truck parts: Parts for foreign and domestic cars and trucks, pulled from our yard.
- Delivery by our own trucks: Our delivery fleet serves Maryland, Delaware, Virginia, the District of Columbia and Pennsylvania.
- Contact us for a bid: Have a vehicle to sell? Get in touch and we'll give you a bid.
- Tire mounting: One reviewer said the staff agreed to help mount an aggressive tire on their car.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. Parts carry a 4 month standard warranty, and extended warranties are available.

Q: How often does your delivery fleet run?
A: Our trucks deliver six days a week. Call or email us for delivery details.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: On Saturday we're open from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM.
